rules.statement: A sale of land under the Irrigation Ordinance vests title absolutely in the Crown free from all encumbrances, and any previous titles are extinguished or suspended by operation of law.
rules.supporting_quote: "Sub-section (2) of section 66 deals with a purchase on behalf of the Crown and in such a case, in terms of the prescribed certificate of sale, on the issue thereof the land would vest absolutely in the Crown free from all encumbrances."
